description: A Visual Studio-style workflow in VS Code, VSCodium, Cursor and Windsurf: Solution Explorer, NuGet, Test Explorer, Error List, Run & Debug, Configuration Manager, Publish.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: Shinobi .NET Studio builds and runs the .NET projects of the folder (dotnet, MSBuild, tests), which executes code from the workspace.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces.descripti: Shinobi .NET Studio needs the files of the solution on a disk where the dotnet CLI can read them.
configuration.0.title: Solution Explorer
config.shinobi.solutionExplorer.location: Choose where the Solution Explorer appears
Show Solution Explorer in the left sidebar (Sidebar)
Show Solution Explorer in the right sidebar (Secondary Sidebar)
Don't move the Solution Explorer: keep it wherever you drag it
config.shinobi.solutionExplorer.fileNest: How files nest under related files, like the File Nesting button in Visual Studio's Solution Explorer.
No nesting: every file shows in its folder

Visual Studio's default rules: code-behind (Index.cshtml.cs), designer files, configuration variants (appsettings.Development.json), resources, parts of a partial class (Order.Lines.cs under Order.cs)
The default rules plus web assets: compiled, minified and map files under their source (site.ts > site.js > site.min.js)
config.shinobi.solutionExplorer.trackAct: Select the active editor's file in the Solution Explorer whenever you switch files, like Visual Studio's *Track Active Item in Solution Explorer*. Without it, use *Sync with Active Document* (`Ctrl+[, S`).
config.shinobi.solution.offerSlnxConvers: When a `.sln` opens, offer to convert it to `.slnx`, the current solution format (*Don't Ask Again* turns it off for one solution).
config.shinobi.nuget.offerV3Migration.ma: When a solution's `NuGet.Config` lists nuget.org by its old address (`https://www.nuget.org/api/v2/`, or `.../api/v3/` without `index.json`), offer to change it to `https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json`: the V2 feed has no vulnerability data (*Don't Ask Again* turns it off for one solution).
config.shinobi.solution.offerNugetConfig: When a solution has a Visual Studio-era `.nuget/NuGet.Config` and no `nuget.config` next to it, offer to move it there: `dotnet restore` does not read the `.nuget` folder (*Don't Ask Again* turns it off for one solution).
configuration.1.title: Error List
config.shinobi.diagnostics.showErrors.de: Show errors in the Error List and mark them in the Solution Explorer (the Error List's Errors toggle)
Show warnings in the Error List and mark them in the Solution Explorer (the Error List's Warnings toggle)
config.shinobi.diagnostics.showInfos.des: Show infos and suggestions (the ··· hints in the editor, Visual Studio's "Messages") in the Error List and mark them in the Solution Explorer (the Error List's Messages toggle)
config.shinobi.solutionExplorer.diagnost: Also mark infos and suggestions (the ··· hints in the editor, Visual Studio's "Messages") in the Solution Explorer; errors and warnings are always marked
configuration.2.title: Run & Debug
config.shinobi.debug.console.markdownDes: Where the program started by F5, Ctrl+F5, Start New Instance and startup profiles reads and writes the console. Applies to the next start.
config.shinobi.debug.console.enumDescrip: The program's input and output are in a VS Code terminal.
The program gets a console window of its own, like Visual Studio's console applications.
Output goes to the Debug Console, which has no input (Console.ReadLine gets nothing).
config.shinobi.debug.checkDevCertificate: When a project with an `https://` launch profile starts (F5, Ctrl+F5, Start New Instance, startup profiles), check once per session whether the HTTPS development certificate is trusted and offer to trust it. Off: nothing is checked. *Trust HTTPS Development Certificate* in the command palette works either way.
configuration.3.title: Build
Builds started by this extension write what source generators produce (`EmitCompilerGeneratedFiles`), so *Dependencies > Analyzers* can show it. Off: builds write nothing extra and generators show no files.
configuration.4.title: Code Cleanup
config.shinobi.codeCleanup.severity.mark: Which code style rules of the `.editorconfig` Code Cleanup fixes, by the severity the rule has there (`dotnet format style --severity`).
config.shinobi.codeCleanup.severity.enum: Apply the style fixes the .editorconfig sets to suggestion, warning or error
Apply the style fixes the .editorconfig sets to warning or error
Apply only the style fixes the .editorconfig sets to error
configuration.5.title: Tests
Discover tests again after every build, so the Test Explorer stays current. Off (for very large solutions): use the Test Explorer's refresh button.
configuration.6.title: NuGet
config.shinobi.nuget.includePrerelease.m: Open the NuGet Package Manager with *Include prerelease* checked.
config.shinobi.nuget.packageSources.mark: Manage package sources in the NuGet Package Manager like Visual Studio: a *Sources* tab to add, remove, enable and disable feeds, and *Package Source Mapping* (`<packageSourceMapping>` in `NuGet.Config`) shown in the package details and respected by Browse.
